titulo: Lists of admitted and excluded applicants
navegacion: Lists of admitted and excluded applicants

ayuda_pasos.1: Prepare the provisional or final list with the admission preparer and open it in "Open prepared list".
ayuda_pasos.2: In the provisional list, each excluded application shows its reasons and whether it can be corrected. If one reason cannot be corrected, the applicant stays excluded even after correcting the others.
ayuda_pasos.3: In the final list, each admitted application shows whether it was already admitted or got in after a correction or complaint, and each excluded one shows the remaining reasons and what was decided.
ayuda_pasos.4: The list is a draft: it is neither approved nor published, and shows no names until publication. The file is only opened on this device and is removed when you close it or leave.

archivo_pista: The .json file produced by admission preparation. Up to 8 MB.
vacio: Open a list to review it.
descarga_lista: Download prepared with the original file.
error_tamano: The file cannot be opened: it is empty or larger than 8 MB. Choose the file produced by admission preparation.
error_formato: The file cannot be opened: it is not a list from the admission preparer. Generate it again and select it.
error_catalogo: The texts could not be loaded. Reload the screen before opening a file.

kpi.tras_escrito: Of which, after correction or complaint

motivo_sin_texto: Reason "{codigo}" has no text in this language

pendientes.aprobacion_competente: Approval of the list by the competent body.
pendientes.identidad_publicacion: Name, surnames and masked document of each applicant, sorted by surname.
pendientes.vencimiento_al_publicar: Calculation of the last day for corrections, from the day after publication.
pendientes.publicacion_oficial: Publication in the official gazette and on the site set by the call rules.
pendientes.catalogo_ejemplo: Replace the example reasons and deadline with the ones HR confirms.

pendientes_definitiva.aprobacion_competente: Approval of the final list by the competent body.
pendientes_definitiva.pie_recursos: State in the decision the available appeals, the body that hears them and the deadline.
pendientes_definitiva.ultima_revision: Check that the provisional list it starts from is the latest published revision.
pendientes_definitiva.registro_escritos: Check that every correction or complaint was registered within the deadline.
